attackers_goals: Data exfiltration, attack tool staging or command and control channel through a trusted service.
description: Abnormal network communication with a rare combination of HTTP User Agent and HTTP Server to an external address.
investigative_actions: Examine the legitimacy of the application that produced this rare combination of HTTP User Agent with the external HTTP Server. Examine the parent process of this application. Check for anomalies at the time when the communication occurred.
name: Abnormal network communication with a rare combination of HTTP User Agent and HTTP Server
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
